data.body: **P2 — Preserve the plugin failure contract for empty error containers.** Returning `null` here makes `OperationEndInfo.error` and `OperationChangeItemInfo.error` null for a terminal failed operation, contrary to their public contract that the value is non-null on failure. Existing plugins using `error != null` will silently miss these failures. Continue returning a `DurableOperationException`, and make the OTel plugin separately detect an empty `ErrorObject` when deciding whether to add ERROR status or exception events; add a non-OTel plugin compatibility test.
